WITH claim_amts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage cc
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount pa
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
party_names AS (
    SELECT
        pt.Party_Identifier,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', per.First_Name, per.Middle_Name, per.Last_Name)), ''),
            org.Organization_Name,
            org.Alternate_Name,
            CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
        ) AS party_display_name
    FROM acme_insurance.main.party pt
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person per ON per.Person_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.organizations org ON org.Organization_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN prl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%holder%' THEN CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR) END, ', ') AS policy_holder_party_id,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN prl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%holder%' THEN pn.party_display_name END, ', ') AS policy_holder_name,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN prl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agent%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%agent%' THEN CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR) END, ', ') AS agent_party_id,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN prl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agent%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%agent%' THEN pn.party_display_name END, ', ') AS agent_name
    FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role prl ON prl.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party_names pn ON pn.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    pp.policy_holder_party_id,
    pp.policy_holder_name,
    pp.agent_party_id,
    pp.agent_name,
    prem.premium_amount,
    ca.loss_payment_amount,
    ca.loss_reserve_amount,
    ca.expense_payment_amount,
    ca.expense_reserve_amount
FROM acme_insurance.main.claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amts ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number
LIMIT 500

  SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Party_Identifier, apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%agent%' OR LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%agent%'
),
policy_claim AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage cc
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
expense_reserve_by_claim AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  ap.Agent_Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
  p.Policy_Identifier,
  p.Policy_Number,
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  c.Company_Claim_Number,
  erc.Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM agent_policy ap
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_claim pc ON pc.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN expense_reserve_by_claim erc ON erc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY Agent_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
LIMIT 500
